title: Diagnosing Structural Fragility in LLM Reasoning
summary: Multi-probe method spanning rename, session coupling, and contamination exposure to distinguish retrieval from genuine reasoning in LLMs. Adversarial perturbation tests across 5 frontier LLMs with statistical significance testing.

title: Diffusion-Generated Volatility Surfaces for RL Hedging
summary: Built NIFTY 50 IV surfaces from 912K+ option rows using conditional DDPMs (0.005 arbitrage penalty vs market 0.009), then trained a PPO hedging agent that reduced CVaR(95%) hedge error by 60.1% vs Black-Scholes.

title: Small Document VLM for OCR Evaluation
summary: Evaluating small vision-language models on document OCR tasks, with a focus on failure modes on structured and low-resource documents.

title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Paradigms for Nonlinear Dynamics, ML, and Autonomous Systems
summary: Unified framework covering Carleman linearization, quantum Fokker-Planck embedding, VQAs for PDEs, quantum RL, and quantum game theory, with hardware and energy-efficiency comparisons.

title: OmniMesh
summary: Offline-first disaster response mesh network using Android phones as triage nodes. Six-agent FastAPI backend running Gemma-2-9B on vLLM-ROCm.

title: FraudScope360
status: National Winner, Citi Bank Campus Innovation Challenge
summary: 5-module fraud engine using graph embedding, anomaly detection, and feature engineering to detect fraud rings and identity fraud, built on Graph ML and XGBoost.
